jobs.title: Mechanical Development & Test Engineer I
jobs.description_text: SPACE SYSTEMS At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. jobs.description_text: NEUTRON Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle being developed by Rocket Lab, a publicly traded end-to-end space company. This role will focus on strengthening compliance operations, managing Strata’s compliance technology, supporting SOC 2 activities, and advancing Strata’s Third-Party Risk Management program. The position works collaboratively to ensure Strata complies with industry regulations, client requirements, and best practices. This is an opportunity to help shape how GRC operates at Strata. You’ll have meaningful ownership of our compliance technology, with the opportunity to automate manual processes, mature established SOC and Third-Party Risk programs, and build scalable GRC practices as our compliance needs continue to evolve. This role requires in-office presence at Strata’s Chicago office two days per week. Candidates should be comfortable working within this hybrid model. Key Responsibilities: Manage and optimize Strata’s compliance platform, including platform administration, configuration, integrations, and ongoing improvements, while identifying and implementing opportunities to automate evidence collection, control monitoring, workflows, and other repeatable compliance activities Own and coordinate SOC 2 Type II activities, including audit readiness, evidence management, control testing, and remediation Own, mature, and expand Third-Party Risk Management and security due diligence processes

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the role We build the AI layer for Starburst's products, including AIDA. We design agents that let users ask questions in natural language and get accurate, grounded answers backed by their actual data. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated agent engineering hire on the team. You will raise the bar on agent reliability, turning shipped features into systems users depend on. You will approach AI agents as production software systems, built with the same rigor as any large-scale backend platform. This is not a research role or a prototyping role. You will ship agentic features that work with messy real-world data, undocumented schemas, and diverse access patterns. You have already shipped agentic or LLM-powered systems at an AI startup or AI-focused product team. You bring proven patterns, knowledge of real failure modes, and operational lessons that would take the team months to learn through trial and error. You write code every day and ship every week. As an AI Agent Engineer at Starburst, you will: Design and build agent architectures: tool orchestration, planning, memory, multi-step reasoning, error recovery Ship production-quality agent features with clear ownership from design through deployment Close the gap between demo and production: handle partial schemas, inconsistent metadata, mixed data formats, and unreliable source systems Introduce proven patterns for agent reliabili

Research and engineering are not separate tracks here. You will own experiments end to end, from hypothesis through production deployment. jobs.description_text: About the role Building a great product is not the same as successfully bringing it to market. Every roadmap conversation, launch, webpage, sales deck, and customer evaluation is an opportunity to tell a clear, consistent story. We’re seeking an Associate Product Marketing Manager to help make Starburst easier to understand, buy, and sell. You will translate technical product capabilities into clear customer value, bring new products and features to market, and connect what we build to the revenue plays that help customers discover, evaluate, and purchase Starburst. This role reports to the Head of Product Marketing within the Product organization. You will work closely with Product Managers and Engineering while collaborating across Marketing and GTM—including content, demand generation, Sales Development Representatives, Account Executives, Solution Architects, RevOps, and enablement. We are building a small, high-impact Product Marketing function, so this is a hands-on builder role. Every PMM must be able to connect product, launch, marketing, and field execution, although successful candidates may bring deeper experience in either product and launches or GTM and sales plays. jobs.description_text: About the role Starburst's Enterprise Context Layer turns scattered data into governed, versioned Data Products — business definitions, access policy, and lineage built in — so BI tools, applications, and AI agents all work from the same trusted answer. As a Senior Software Engineer at Starburst you will : Design, build, and operate backend services that collect and reconcile business context from a variety of existing systems into governed Context Studio. jobs.description_text: About the role Starburst is looking for strong Java engineers to work with our globally distributed engineering team on the core of Starburst's software. This role sits on the Control Plane team, whose mandate is to converge the control planes of our two flagship deployment models, self-managed Starburst Enterprise Platform (SEP) and fully managed Starburst Galaxy, into a single, unified platform. You will design and build backend services and cloud infrastructure that run in both worlds: multi-tenant SaaS at global scale, and customer-operated on-premise and air-gapped deployments. Both models bring unique and interesting problems, and incredible learning opportunities for any engineer. Starburst offers the opportunity to compete at global scale with other elite vendors in the Data Analytics space and external customers. As a Senior Software Engineer, Control Plane at Starburst you will: Design, develop, and maintain control plane services shared by Starburst Enterprise , Starburst Galaxy , and Trino . Contribute to the Unified Control Plane: take capabilities that exist in one product (access control, multi-cluster management, routing, catalog management, observability) and deliver them as a single implementation that serves both SaaS and self-managed deployments. jobs.description_text: Why you’ll love this role Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact. jobs.title: Young Investigator, Climate Modeling
jobs.description_text: Compensation: $159,650.00 We will begin reviewing applications on October 28, 2026. Who You Are: We seek a Young Investigator for a new three-year project to develop an AI-powered physics-informed hybrid climate model trained on historical data that is capable of multidecadal forecasts that are more accurate than the current state of the art. Note: This position has a three year term . As a YI, you will lead the design and evaluation of NeuralGCM+ training and testing cases, using both historical data and customized physics-based climate model outputs, and collaborate with other team members on conceiving and implementing NeuralGCM+ model improvements suggested by these cases. You will also have the opportunity to set up and test your own novel applications of NeuralGCM+. You'll get to work on: Select, design and evaluate NeuralGCM+ training and testing cases, using both historical data and customized physics-based climate model outputs. Conceiving and implementing NeuralGCM+ model improvements that increase its generalizability to unseen climates and improve the simulated coupling between earth system components such as the atmosphere, ocean, land, and sea ice, in collaboration with other team members. Mentoring interns as appropriate. Have formal graduate-level ML coursework. Team members will be able to receive annual bonuses.
